reason: We've run our practice smoothly on WhatsApp groups and Excel sheets for ten years without paying for software, and WhatsApp direct integration is only on their roadmap. If I test it at all, I'll just stay on the free tier rather than paying ₹12,990.
objection: Why should I pay for new software when my spreadsheets and WhatsApp groups work fine, and WhatsApp integration isn't even live yet?
would_change_my_mind: Direct native WhatsApp integration so neither clients nor staff have to adopt a new tool, plus completely automating my Saturday GST reconciliation.
